data.body: AC amendment (gap analysis): Add PATH-based resolution test for llm-api-call.sh. Add test_runner_resolves_llm_api_call_via_path: set up mock llm-api-call.sh in a temp dir, prepend that dir to PATH, run the runner (without passing llm-api-call.sh as an explicit path), and assert that the mock was invoked (counter file has entries). This verifies the runner uses 'bash "$(command -v llm-api-call.sh)"' or equivalent PATH lookup rather than a hardcoded path.
